notes.title: Dev Update 1: New Character and Engine Upgrades!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

It’s been a minute since the last play session so we’d like to give you a look at what we’ve been hard at work on. 

[olist]
[*] [h2]Item Models![/h2] Say goodbye to those ugly wooden crates on the ground! Now, drops have actual models with VFX and sound. You’ll also be able to click on the items from long range and auto path to pick up the item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/79d8f87fdcdb28f7b27f7def9630c972064b7d82.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/f7b3b047601e0ab108c7858614e4143fed0faacc.png[/img]

[*] [h2]New Level![/h2] We’ll share more of this one later, but it’s called Ancient God Mountain. This level is packed with content! 5 new bosses and 70 monster types! The map genuinely is huge and we think it will take 5+ hours minimum to complete everything on it. Even if you have already completed the map before and sprint to each encounter, it would still take veteran players around 1.5 hours to complete.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/be3a6437cc63db04b2d8118d28f8d990dd9d32d1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/7daab03b5b8a6c8768b640e341007cd511ae5b76.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/1fdd04e2ce0a726d9a350c331ce0d989f0831ded.gif[/img]

[*] [h2]New Playable Character![/h2] Arkimus. Arkimus is an arcane ninja. The ultimate kind of ninja. We’ll share more about Arkimus in a later update! But here's a quick look of him in action.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/ee2d9ba4a734da0dc2549215be029a8283f1b14d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/77dbf510b99843b3518a93ff531d5ba2a796f89b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/264a7ae3320ceea41d0d6e93dd2aacbf4d7e16a0.gif[/img]

[*] [h2]Upgraded The Engine![/h2] to handle improved lighting effects and overall improving the graphics. Compared to the previous build, this upgrade to the engine takes the visuals to the next level. Better lighting, shadows, and overall improved the environment like the grass, trees, and water. Upgrading the engine took the longest to do out of all the other features listed here so we hope you enjoy the new look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/a4b588a3412e938cd7db3a6f02383449d6bab297.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049916/34e6be7e02ce50f6f26cf48357b1729976743bff.png[/img]
[/olist]

Thanks for reading and we hope to bring you another update next month to keep you up to date with what we’re doing.

-Roshpit devs
